layouts.name: Historical short course
layouts.description: Historical short-course draft retains the complete southern S and eastern short closing bend from exact OSM way 261993714 version 8. The northern extension and alternate parallel western return are excluded. The championship organizer confirms a separately raced Circuito Chico in its 2017 event schedule. The independent source measures 3,049.0 m, versus the published 3,120 m short-course distance; exact event-year corner placement and direction remain unverified. No points are fitted or extended to meet that distance.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: Configuration set retains the full northern extension, southern S and separate eastern short-course closing bend. The championship organizer confirms independently raced long and short courses. Both paths retain exact OSM way 261993714 version 8; the northern extension retains exact way 544373728 version 2. The additional parallel western return, pit approach and tiny southern connector are excluded because they are absent from the supplied configuration identity. The short route measures 3,049.0 m against the 2017 published 3,120 m; historical-year corner placement remains draft. Shared mapped edges count once; the 4,876.9 m branch network is not one lap. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
